## Missing Coverage (➕)

These commands exist in `src/obs.zsh` (lines 645–740) and `src/python/obs_cli.py` (lines 842–860) but have **zero documentation** in `cli-reference.md`, `refcard.md`, or any tutorial:

| Command | ZSH handler | CLI parser help | MCP tool | Gap |
|---------|------------|-----------------|----------|-----|
| `obs bridge status` | `obs_bridge()` | `Show Obsidian CLI bridge status` | `get_bridge_status` | No CLI doc section |
| `obs trends <vault>` | `obs_trends()` | `Show vault activity trends (weekly buckets)` | `get_trends` | No CLI doc section |
| `obs stale <vault>` | `obs_stale()` | `Find stale high-importance notes` | `get_stale_notes` | No CLI doc section |
| `obs daily-digest <vault>` | `obs_daily_digest()` | `Combined bridge + trends + stale summary` | `get_daily_digest` | No CLI doc section |
| `obs doctor` | `obs_doctor()` | `Run self-diagnostic checks` | `diagnose` | No CLI doc section |

Note: `obs scan` was added to `cli-reference.md` in the prior session (2026-06-23, PR #57). It is still missing from `refcard.md`.

## Priority Action Plan

### High Priority

**1. Add 5 missing command sections to `cli-reference.md`**

Add after the `obs health` section (Vault Management group) or as a new "Monitoring & Diagnostics" group:

- `obs bridge status` — show Obsidian CLI bridge status (native CLI installed + app running)
- `obs trends <vault> [--days N]` — weekly activity buckets; `--days` default 90
- `obs stale <vault> [--limit N]` — find high-PageRank notes not updated recently; `--limit` default 20
- `obs daily-digest <vault>` — combined bridge + trends + stale output; `--limit` default 5
- `obs doctor [--vault NAME]` — self-diagnostic; checks DB, deps, MCP config, doc counts
